35 30 17 The Legend of the Old Shepherd Xeudi and His Friend Reimann
introduction: In his last and only long film Hans-Jakob Siber tells the legend of the old shepherd Xeudi, who sells his property and henceforth finds no peace in the style of a rock opera. Accompanied by psychedelic music of the pop group The Mandrake Memorial and purely visually narrated, Siber’s Xeudi is a hypnotic trip to the inner world of the old shepherd and the mountains, in which he lives.
